newsitem.title: USA: US Justice Dept seeks Cox acquisition data.
newsitem.headline: US Justice Dept seeks Cox acquisition data.

text.p: Cox Radio Inc Monday said that the Antitrust Division of the U.S. Department of Justice has requested information related to Cox's pending acquisition of NewCity Communications.
The Justice Department's Civil Investigative Demand relates to three radio stations owned by Syracuse, N.Y.-based NewCity.
Cox already owns two radio stations in Syracuse.
Cox said it still expects to close its acquisition of NewCity as scheduled in the first half of 1997 upon approval from the Federal Communications Commission.

Cox anticipates that the FCC approval is forthcoming, and notes that the Justice Department told Cox it has not asked the FCC to hold up the licensing application submitted in connection with with Cox's acquisition of NewCity.
